source: Bureau of Economic Analysis, price index for state and local government gross investment in structures (national income and product accounts table 3.9.4, line 36), quarterly, seasonally adjusted, 2017 = 100; FRED series B842RG3Q086SBEA
method: Fiscal-year average of the four quarters from July through June (third and fourth quarters of the prior calendar year, first and second of the fiscal year).
